name: Financial Advice 1 Code
definition: Specifies if advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.

RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: Advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.

NREC.name: Not Received
NREC.definition: Advice has not been received from an independent financial advisor.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: It is not known whether or not advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.
